title: Wanted Criminal Punches Cop In The Face During Arrest
description:
On May 13th, 2022, an officer on patrol observed a vehicle pass by a stop sign activated by a school bus. Upon approaching the vehicle, the officer was informed by the driver that there was a warrant out for her arrest. She complied initially but was soon going to escalate the situation. The officer advised the woman that if she had remained calm, none of this would have happened, but she was not ready to listen to him. The female had a previous warrant and was charged with aggravated battery upon a peace officer and resisting arrest.
